description: Reads a regulation (normally BCBS 239) and identifies the OBLIGATIONS it places on the bank — one per principle — with paragraph-level citations, the data concepts the text names, and the measurable expectations that must survive into a policy body. Input is the regulation text as the message; output is a JSON obligation register for human review. Deliberately does NOT identify Critical Data Elements: that step runs later against the published standard, because Alation derives a standard from a policy and a CDE inherits from the standard. Interpretation only — it reads nothing from the catalog and creates nothing.

message.description: Text of the regulation, normally the bank-facing principles 1-11 from artifacts/bcbs239/bank_principles.txt. Send them together, not one principle at a time — the governable/out-of-scope procedure and the cross-cutting obligations both require seeing every principle at once.
